user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for ChatGPT search; sites opted out will not appear in search answers
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt; takes ~24 hours to take effect

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Visits pages submitted as ads to ensure policy compliance and relevance; data not used for training generative AI

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training generative AI foundation models; make models more useful and safe
user_agents.scope: Crawls content used in training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt to prevent content use in AI model training

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs when users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-initiated web page visits; not automatic crawling; robots.txt rules may not apply
user_agents.opt_out: Not used for determining search appearance; use OAI-SearchBot for managing search opt-outs

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt; supports Crawl-delay extension

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieve web content in response to user queries to Claude AI
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch of websites when Claude users ask questions

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyze web content to improve search result quality and relevance
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing and optimization

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google Search indexes and find information for Google Search
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing; affects Google Search, Discover, Images, Video, News

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google Images and image-related search features
user_agents.scope: Image-specific crawling; affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, favicons

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video-specific crawling; affects video-related Google Search features

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News product and news.google.com
user_agents.scope: News-specific crawling; affects Google News product

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl product information for Google Shopping product surfaces
user_agents.scope: E-commerce product crawling; affects all Google Shopping surfaces

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Support Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL Inspection
user_agents.scope: Testing and inspection tool crawling; affects Search Console testing

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various product teams and internal R&D
user_agents.scope: Generic product-agnostic crawling for research and one-off content fetches

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image URL fetching for various product teams
user_agents.scope: Generic image-specific crawling optimized for fetching image URLs

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video URL fetching for various product teams
user_agents.scope: Generic video-specific crawling optimized for fetching video URLs

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Support crawling for site owners building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI-specific crawling requested by site owners

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control Gemini model training and grounding content from crawled sites
user_agents.scope: Manages content usage for Gemini training and grounding; not used for Search ranking

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result surfacing and linking; not used for AI model training
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow PerplexityBot in robots.txt file; verify against published IP ranges

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions within Perplexity when answering questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web page fetches for accurate answers; generally ignores robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Control via robots.txt rules, though generally ignored for user-triggered requests

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Search crawling for Spotlight, Siri, and Safari search results
user_agents.scope: General web crawl across Apple ecosystem; powers search technology integrated into user experiences
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt via 'User-agent: Applebot' directive; also respects Googlebot rules if Applebot not mentioned

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for Apple foundation models powering generative AI features
user_agents.scope: Determines how crawled data is used for Apple Intelligence, Services, and Developer Tools; does not crawl webpages itself
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt via 'User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: /' directive

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawling URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Apple Podcasts specific crawling; does not follow robots.txt as not a general search crawler

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shared content on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger to gather and cache metadata like title, description, and thumbnail images
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta family of apps; may bypass robots.txt for security/integrity checks
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rule to robots.txt; note that crawler may bypass for malware/integrity checks

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Index web content to improve Meta AI search result quality and relevance for users
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enhance Meta AI search results and citation capabilities

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web for improving advertising and other business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for advertising and business product improvements

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for AI model training and product indexing

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities and task completion
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for evaluating and improving agentic AI; may bypass robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: meta-externalfetcher / Disallow: /' to robots.txt; note may bypass for user-requested fetches

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Bing search index crawling and updates
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search results indexing

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Preview generation for Bing search results
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches for generating preview snippets

user_agents.name: Slurp
user_agents.purpose: Yahoo search index crawling (Microsoft partnership)
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing

user_agents.name: MSNBot
user_agents.purpose: Legacy Microsoft search index crawling
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search results

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services, train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product and service improvements

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services
user_agents.scope: Content indexing for Alexa and Rufus search features

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions requiring up-to-date information
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live web information for Alexa queries

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for building Common Crawl dataset
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, respects robots.txt and Sitemap Protocol

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for building Common Crawl dataset (legacy version)
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, respects robots.txt and Sitemap Protocol
